class.name: DragonBonesData
class.brief_description: Describes the data source of one DragonBones data set.
class.description: One resource per DragonBones data set. It only describes the data source (a skeleton file plus one texture source) and acts as the bridge between [DragonBonesArmatureView] and the internal factory. It does not parse data, build armatures, or cache runtime objects. There are two ways a resource is managed. When imported automatically by the editor, [member ske_file] and [member texture_source] only store a file or folder name which is resolved relative to the resource file, and the fields are read-only. When created by the user, they store full paths and are freely editable.

method.name: build_armature
method.description: Builds an armature instance from this data set (the data is loaded on demand). This is the bridge entry point used by [DragonBonesArmatureView]; the view does not access the internal factory directly.

method.name: get_armature_names
method.description: The armature names contained in this data set.

method.name: get_skin_names
method.description: The skin names of the given armature in this data set.

method.name: get_effective_cache_name
method.description: The cache key of this data set in the (global) factory, derived from a per-resource auto-incrementing id. Because all resources share one factory, the key must be unique per set — the name embedded in the skeleton JSON can collide between different armatures, and a resource created in code has no path to use as a key.

method.name: resolve_ske_path
method.description: The resolved skeleton file path. When imported automatically this is the resource's own directory joined with [member ske_file]; otherwise it is [member ske_file] as-is.

method.name: resolve_texture_source_path
method.description: The resolved texture source path. Resolution follows the same rule as [method resolve_ske_path].

members.member: The texture source. It is a [code]*_tex.json[/code] file, or a [code]*_texture/[/code] folder, depending on [member texture_source_type].
Whether [member texture_source] points to a packed texture atlas or to a folder of standalone images.

constants.constant: [member texture_source] is a packed texture atlas json file.
[member texture_source] is a folder of standalone images (Images export mode).
